project.name: MysTherm
project.description: Marketing website for MysTherm — a French biocomposite insulation startup producing mycelium-based sandwich panels. Full-stack SPA in French language.

tech_stack.routing: React Router DOM v7 (BrowserRouter, lazy-loaded routes)
tech_stack.3d: Three.js v0.184 (raw, no R3F in production canvases)

design_system.name: Wabi-Sabi Mineral
design_system.philosophy: Warm earthy tones inspired by natural materials — bone, linen, straw, timber, kiln-fired clay. Minimalist. No sharp white. No pure black. Every color references a physical material.

bone.role: Primary background — parchment white. Used for page bg, cards, info panels.

raw-linen.role: Secondary background — slightly darker warm off-white. Used for PropertiesStrip, LayerExplorer section, scrollbar track.

straw.role: Muted mid-tone. Dividers, borders, scroll indicators, badge borders, Three.js ambient light color.

umber.role: Secondary text — muted labels, captions, uppercase tracking tags, back-link buttons.

dark-oak.role: Primary text — readable dark tone. Also Hero section background (not pure black).

obsidian.role: Darkest tone — Navbar bg, SandwichPanel header bg, MaterialStatement bg, Three.js interior layer color. theme-color meta tag.

kiln-red.role: Primary accent / brand color — CTA buttons, active states, hero subheadline, SVG icon strokes, scrollbar thumb, focus rings, Three.js PointLight fill.

celadon.role: Secondary accent — moss/green undertone. Three.js vapour barrier layer, back light, celadon button variant, badge secondary.

css_variables.note: shadcn/ui CSS variable bridge — maps palette to semantic roles

display_font.name: Fraunces
display_font.usage: All headings (h1, h2, h3), hero headlines, editorial text blocks, step numbers. Always font-light (300). Often italic.

body_font.name: Inter
body_font.usage: All body copy, labels, buttons, captions, nav links, form fields.

typography.border_radius: 2px globally (sharp, no rounded corners — architectural aesthetic)

routing.page_loader: Bone bg + kiln-red spinner shown during lazy chunk load
routing.navbar_navigation: isRoute:true → navigate(href), isRoute:false/undefined → scrollIntoView(). If not on home and hash link clicked → navigate('/') then setTimeout scroll 300ms.

home.description: Main marketing landing page — full single-page scroll experience.

products.description: Editorial product showcase page — full-viewport imagery, grid layout, material philosophy, technical specs, CTA.

sandwich_panel.description: Interactive 3D layer explorer — CSS perspective diagram with clickable layers, animated info panel, thickness selector.

Navbar.description: Fixed top navigation bar with scroll-aware bg opacity, logo, desktop nav, mobile hamburger, CTA button.
Navbar.background: bg-obsidian (#2A2318), 95% opacity when not scrolled, full opacity + shadow when scrolled
Navbar.logo: React Router <Link to='/'>. 'Mys' in kiln-red italic, 'Therm' in bone italic. Both Fraunces 300.
Navbar.nav_links: font-body text-bone/60 → text-bone on hover. 6 links (3 hash-scroll, 2 route, 1 hash).
Navbar.cta_button: Devis Gratuit — kiln-red bg, bone text, navigates to #contact
Navbar.animation: Slide down on mount: opacity 0→1, y -20→0, 0.4s delay 0.1s

MobileMenu.description: Animated dropdown nav for mobile. Full-width obsidian bg, stacked buttons, CTA at bottom.

Footer.description: Site footer with brand statement, nav links, legal info.

Hero.shimmer_line: Animated h-px scaleX 0→1 at top edge, via straw/30, 1.6s ease
Hero.layout: 2-col grid on lg (text left, 3D canvas right), single col on mobile

text_animations.badge: delay 0.1s — straw outline badge, uppercase tracking
text_animations.h1_line2: delay 0.44s — Fraunces 300 italic kiln-red accent line
text_animations.trust_items: delay 0.95s, 0.06s stagger — 3 items: 🌿 100% Biosourcé, 🔥 Ignifuge, 🇫🇷 Fabriqué en France

Hero.3d_canvas: Lazy-loaded HeroCanvas — Three.js procedural sandwich panel model with rotate/orbit animation

StatsBar.description: 3 animated statistics: 0.038 W/m·K conductivité, 45 dB réduction acoustique, 100% biosourcé.
StatsBar.animation: useCountUp hook — cubic ease, IntersectionObserver triggered
StatsBar.background: raw-linen or obsidian (check file for exact value)

HowItWorks.description: 3-step process: 01 Diagnostic Énergétique, 02 Pose des Panneaux, 03 Certification & Garantie.

ProductStack.description: Product comparison: MysTherm Standard (40–80mm, λ 0.038) vs MysTherm Premium (80–120mm, λ 0.035).
ProductStack.includes: LayerExploderCanvas — Three.js exploded layer stack animation

Benefits.description: 4 benefit cards: Isolation Thermique Supérieure, Confort Acoustique, Résistance au Feu, 100% Biosourcé.

Testimonials.description: 2 client testimonials: Jean-Pierre Moreau (propriétaire, Lyon), Sophie Blanc (architecte DPLG, Paris). Both 5-star ratings.

ContactForm.description: Lead capture form — react-hook-form + Zod validation. Headline: 'Parlons de votre projet'. Subheadline: 'Obtenez une étude thermique gratuite'.

ProductHero.headline: 'Grown, not made.' — Fraunces 300 italic bone, clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5.5rem), delay 0.4s
ProductHero.subtitle: Italic font-body text-straw text-sm tracking-[0.08em], delay 0.65s
ProductHero.scroll_indicator: Animated vertical gradient line, straw/50, pulse loop, opacity fades in at delay 1.2s

EditorialGrid.description: Asymmetric 3-column CSS grid of 4 product photos.

grid_layout.cell_1: product-cubes-stack.jpg — col 1, row-span-2, aspect 3/4. Caption: 'Grades de densité — fin, médium, brut'
grid_layout.cell_2: product-hex-tiles.jpg — col 2-3, row 1, aspect 16/9. Caption: 'Tuiles hexagonales — modulaires et emboîtables'
grid_layout.cell_3: product-panel-frame.jpg — col 2, row 2, aspect 1/1. Caption: 'Panneaux encadrés — prêts à poser'
grid_layout.cell_4: product-mycelium-bag.jpg — col 3, row 2, aspect 1/1. Caption: 'Substrat vivant — matière première'

EditorialGrid.image_hover: filter saturate(0.85) default → saturate(1) + scale(1.03) on hover. transition 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.25,0.1,0.25,1)
EditorialGrid.caption: Absolute bottom-left, Inter 300 11px bone uppercase tracking-[0.1em]. opacity 0 + translateY → opacity 1 on group hover
EditorialGrid.animation: Framer Motion staggered fade-in on scroll, 0.1s stagger, once:true

MaterialStatement.description: Full-bleed editorial section — animated counter + editorial paragraph.
MaterialStatement.left_col: 40% — '100%' Fraunces 300 italic straw, clamp(5rem, 12vw, 10rem). Label 'biosourcé' Inter 300 uppercase umber tracking-[0.2em]
MaterialStatement.counter: useCountUp hook, 0→100, 2200ms duration, cubic ease-out, triggered by useInView (Framer Motion)
MaterialStatement.right_col: 60% — editorial paragraph in Fraunces 300 text-raw-linen, font-size 1.2rem, line-height 1.9, max-width 520px
MaterialStatement.paragraph_text: Le mycélium — réseau racinaire du champignon — est cultivé sur des substrats agricoles locaux. En quelques jours, il colonise le moule, se solidifie, et crée un matériau d'isolation naturel, sans colle, sans plastique, sans empreinte carbone excessive.
MaterialStatement.animation: Left col: x -20→0, opacity, delay 0. Right col: x 20→0, opacity, delay 0.15s.

PropertiesStrip.description: 5 technical properties in a horizontal strip.
PropertiesStrip.dividers: 0.5px vertical line #C4B49A between items (desktop only, absolute positioned)
PropertiesStrip.animation: Framer Motion staggered slide-up on scroll, 0.08s stagger, once:true

ProductCTA.description: Bottom CTA strip linking to contact form on home page.
ProductCTA.text: 'Intéressé par nos panneaux pour votre projet ?' — Fraunces 300 italic dark-oak, 1.4rem
ProductCTA.button: Demander un devis — bg-kiln-red text-bone, rounded-sm, navigate('/#contact') via useNavigate
ProductCTA.layout: Desktop: flex-row space-between. Mobile: flex-col centered.

LayerDiagram.description: CSS 3D perspective representation of the sandwich panel — NOT Three.js.
LayerDiagram.initial_animation: spring stiffness 120, damping 18. rotateX 0→10deg, rotateY 0→-15deg, opacity 0.4→1, scale 0.9→1. Delay 0.3s.

interaction.click_active: scale 1.05, translateY -4px, brightness 1.05 (Framer Motion spring stiffness 200 damping 25)
interaction.reset: clicking active layer again → activeLayer null (back to full opacity)

LayerInfoPanel.description: Contextual info panel that changes content based on which layer is selected.
LayerInfoPanel.transition: AnimatePresence mode='wait' — exit x -24 opacity 0, enter x 24 opacity 0, center x 0 opacity 1. Duration 0.35s.
